706640101.text: Every time there's trouble, they send me to fix it...

706640104.text: It's you! What a coincidence! I never expected to meet you here of all places.

706640106.text: *sigh* Don't ask. Remember that peculiar Domain? You know... the one where the internal structure changed according to one's mind?

706640107.text: I was able to gather quite a lot of information thanks to your help in getting me in there to explore. After the Domain disappeared, I went back to report to Lan.

706640108.text: I reiterated to her that I couldn't have managed this case without your help. I only provided a negligible amount of support.

706640109.text: But she wouldn't listen and even commended my work before asking me to lead a team to explore more unknown Domains of that sort.
